attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine if corporation must file Texas franchise tax return. Checks for physical presence, economic nexus, or Texas registration. No tax due threshold: $1.23M in total revenue.

condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_physical_presence true beq { pop apportionment.state_code "TX" streq } over if

condition_details.condition_comment: Meets Texas economic nexus threshold ($500K Texas receipts)
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus true beq { pop apportionment.state_code "TX" streq } over if

condition_details.condition_comment: Total revenue below $1.23M no-tax-due threshold; result.tx_total_revenue < result.tx_no_tax_due_threshold

action_details.action_comment: Physical presence but below threshold - no tax due; No tax due - total revenue below $1.23M threshold
action_details.action_dsl: set tx_result.qualifies_for_no_tax_due = true; set tx_result.franchise_tax = 0.0; set apportionment.state_tax = 0.0; add "TX franchise tax: No tax due (revenue below $1.23M threshold). Reference: TX Tax Code 171.002(d)(2)" to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: true cvb /tx_result.qualifies_for_no_tax_due xdef 0.0 cvd /tx_result.franchise_tax xdef 0.0 cvd /apportionment.state_tax xdef "TX franchise tax: No tax due (revenue below $1.23M threshold). Reference: TX Tax Code 171.002(d)(2)" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Physical nexus established - franchise tax calculation required
action_details.action_dsl: set tx_result.qualifies_for_no_tax_due = false; add "TX franchise tax filing required due to physical presence. Reference: TX Tax Code 171.001" to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: false cvb /tx_result.qualifies_for_no_tax_due xdef "TX franchise tax filing required due to physical presence. Reference: TX Tax Code 171.001" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Economic nexus established - franchise tax calculation required; TX franchise tax filing required due to economic nexus ($500K threshold)
action_details.action_dsl: set tx_result.qualifies_for_no_tax_due = false; add "TX franchise tax filing required due to economic nexus ($500K TX receipts). Reference: TX Tax Code 171.0001(a)(1)" to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: false cvb /tx_result.qualifies_for_no_tax_due xdef "TX franchise tax filing required due to economic nexus ($500K TX receipts). Reference: TX Tax Code 171.0001(a)(1)" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No nexus - no filing required; No Texas nexus - no filing requirement
action_details.action_dsl: set tx_result.qualifies_for_no_tax_due = true; set tx_result.franchise_tax = 0.0; set apportionment.state_tax = 0.0; set apportionment.state_refund_or_owed = apportionment.state_payments; add "No TX nexus - no filing required. Any estimated payments would be refunded." to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: true cvb /tx_result.qualifies_for_no_tax_due xdef 0.0 cvd /tx_result.franchise_tax xdef 0.0 cvd /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments cvd /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "No TX nexus - no filing required. Any estimated payments would be refunded." job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine which deduction method produces the lowest franchise tax liability. Taxpayer can choose COGS, compensation, or 70% of revenue.

condition_details.condition_comment: Has nexus and above no-tax-due threshold; result.tx_qualifies_for_no_tax_due == false

action_details.action_comment: No nexus or below threshold - deduction method not applicable; No franchise tax due - deduction method not applicable
action_details.action_dsl: set tx_result.deduction_method = "none"; set tx_result.margin_deduction = 0.0; add "No TX franchise tax due - deduction method not applicable." to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: "none" cvs /tx_result.deduction_method xdef 0.0 cvd /tx_result.margin_deduction xdef "No TX franchise tax due - deduction method not applicable." job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Use 70% of revenue deduction; 70% of revenue provides largest deduction (simplified method)
action_details.action_dsl: set tx_result.deduction_method = "70_percent"; set tx_result.margin_deduction = tx_result.total_revenue * 0.70; add "TX franchise tax: Using 70% of revenue deduction method. Reference: TX Tax Code 171.1012(f)" to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: "70_percent" cvs /tx_result.deduction_method xdef tx_result.total_revenue 0.70 fmul cvd /tx_result.margin_deduction xdef "TX franchise tax: Using 70% of revenue deduction method. Reference: TX Tax Code 171.1012(f)" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_dsl: set tx_result.deduction_method = "cogs"; set tx_result.margin_deduction = tx_result.cogs; add "TX franchise tax: Using COGS deduction method. Reference: TX Tax Code 171.1012(i)" to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: "cogs" cvs /tx_result.deduction_method xdef tx_result.cogs cvd /tx_result.margin_deduction xdef "TX franchise tax: Using COGS deduction method. Reference: TX Tax Code 171.1012(i)" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_dsl: set tx_result.deduction_method = "compensation"; set tx_result.margin_deduction = tx_result.compensation; add "TX franchise tax: Using compensation deduction method. Reference: TX Tax Code 171.1012(f)" to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: "compensation" cvs /tx_result.deduction_method xdef tx_result.compensation cvd /tx_result.margin_deduction xdef "TX franchise tax: Using compensation deduction method. Reference: TX Tax Code 171.1012(f)" job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Texas taxable margin for franchise tax. Margin = Revenue - (COGS or Compensation or 70% of Revenue)

condition_details.condition_comment: Has nexus and above no-tax-due threshold; result.tx_qualifies_for_no_tax_due == false
Qualifies for E-Z computation ($20M or less in revenue)

action_details.action_comment: No nexus or below threshold - no margin calculation; No franchise tax due - margin calculation not applicable
action_details.action_dsl: set tx_result.taxable_margin = 0.0; set tx_result.apportioned_margin = 0.0; add "No TX franchise tax due - margin calculation not applicable." to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 cvd /tx_result.taxable_margin xdef 0.0 cvd /tx_result.apportioned_margin xdef "No TX franchise tax due - margin calculation not applicable." job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: E-Z Computation option available; Calculate margin - E-Z computation available ($20M or less)
action_details.action_dsl: set tx_result.qualifies_for_ez_computation = true; set tx_result.taxable_margin = the maximum of (tx_result.total_revenue - tx_result.margin_deduction) and (0.0); set tx_result.apportioned_margin = tx_result.taxable_margin * apportionment.apportionment_factor; add "TX margin calculated. E-Z computation available. Reference: TX Tax Code 171.1016" to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: true cvb /tx_result.qualifies_for_ez_computation xdef tx_result.total_revenue tx_result.margin_deduction f- 0.0 fmax cvd /tx_result.taxable_margin xdef tx_result.taxable_margin apportionment.apportionment_factor fmul cvd /tx_result.apportioned_margin xdef "TX margin calculated. E-Z computation available. Reference: TX Tax Code 171.1016" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Standard margin calculation (no E-Z); Calculate margin - standard method (revenue exceeds $20M)
action_details.action_dsl: set tx_result.qualifies_for_ez_computation = false; set tx_result.taxable_margin = the maximum of (tx_result.total_revenue - tx_result.margin_deduction) and (0.0); set tx_result.apportioned_margin = tx_result.taxable_margin * apportionment.apportionment_factor; add "TX margin calculated using standard method. Reference: TX Tax Code 171.101" to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: false cvb /tx_result.qualifies_for_ez_computation xdef tx_result.total_revenue tx_result.margin_deduction f- 0.0 fmax cvd /tx_result.taxable_margin xdef tx_result.taxable_margin apportionment.apportionment_factor fmul cvd /tx_result.apportioned_margin xdef "TX margin calculated using standard method. Reference: TX Tax Code 171.101" job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Texas franchise tax liability. Applies 0.75% or 0.375% rate to apportioned margin. IMPORTANT: This is NOT an income tax.

condition_details.condition_comment: Has nexus and above no-tax-due threshold; result.tx_qualifies_for_no_tax_due == false
Elects to use E-Z computation method; result.tx_qualifies_for_ez_computation == true
Primarily engaged in retail or wholesale trade

action_details.action_comment: No nexus or below threshold - no franchise tax; No Texas franchise tax due
action_details.action_dsl: set tx_result.franchise_tax = 0.0; set apportionment.state_tax = 0.0; set apportionment.state_refund_or_owed = apportionment.state_payments; add "No TX franchise tax due. Any estimated payments will be refunded. Reference: TX Tax Code 171.002(d)(2)" to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 cvd /tx_result.franchise_tax xdef 0.0 cvd /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments cvd /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "No TX franchise tax due. Any estimated payments will be refunded. Reference: TX Tax Code 171.002(d)(2)" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: E-Z Computation (simplified method); TX franchise tax using E-Z computation (0.575%)
action_details.action_dsl: set tx_result.franchise_tax = (the maximum of (tx_result.total_revenue - tx_result.no_tax_due_threshold) and (0.0)) * tx_result.ez_computation_rate * apportionment.apportionment_factor; set tx_result.franchise_tax = the maximum of (tx_result.franchise_tax - apportionment.state_credits) and (0.0); set apportionment.state_tax = tx_result.franchise_tax; set apportionment.state_refund_or_owed = apportionment.state_payments - apportionment.state_tax; add "TX franchise tax: E-Z computation. (Revenue - $1.23M) × 0.575%. NOT an income tax. Reference: TX Tax Code 171.1016" to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: tx_result.total_revenue tx_result.no_tax_due_threshold f- 0.0 fmax tx_result.ez_computation_rate fmul apportionment.apportionment_factor fmul cvd /tx_result.franchise_tax xdef tx_result.franchise_tax apportionment.state_credits f- 0.0 fmax cvd /tx_result.franchise_tax xdef tx_result.franchise_tax cvd /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments apportionment.state_tax f- cvd /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "TX franchise tax: E-Z computation. (Revenue - $1.23M) × 0.575%. NOT an income tax. Reference: TX Tax Code 171.1016" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Retail/wholesale reduced rate (0.375%); TX franchise tax at reduced retail/wholesale rate
action_details.action_dsl: set tx_result.margin_tax_rate = 0.00375; set tx_result.franchise_tax = tx_result.apportioned_margin * tx_result.margin_tax_rate; set tx_result.franchise_tax = the maximum of (tx_result.franchise_tax - apportionment.state_credits) and (0.0); set apportionment.state_tax = tx_result.franchise_tax; set apportionment.state_refund_or_owed = apportionment.state_payments - apportionment.state_tax; add "TX franchise tax: Retail/wholesale rate 0.375%. NOT an income tax. Reference: TX Tax Code 171.002(b)" to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: 0.00375 cvd /tx_result.margin_tax_rate xdef tx_result.apportioned_margin tx_result.margin_tax_rate fmul cvd /tx_result.franchise_tax xdef tx_result.franchise_tax apportionment.state_credits f- 0.0 fmax cvd /tx_result.franchise_tax xdef tx_result.franchise_tax cvd /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments apportionment.state_tax f- cvd /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "TX franchise tax: Retail/wholesale rate 0.375%. NOT an income tax. Reference: TX Tax Code 171.002(b)" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Standard rate (0.75%); TX franchise tax at standard rate
action_details.action_dsl: set tx_result.margin_tax_rate = 0.0075; set tx_result.franchise_tax = tx_result.apportioned_margin * tx_result.margin_tax_rate; set tx_result.franchise_tax = the maximum of (tx_result.franchise_tax - apportionment.state_credits) and (0.0); set apportionment.state_tax = tx_result.franchise_tax; set apportionment.state_refund_or_owed = apportionment.state_payments - apportionment.state_tax; add "TX franchise tax: Standard rate 0.75%. NOT an income tax. Reference: TX Tax Code 171.002(a)" to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0075 cvd /tx_result.margin_tax_rate xdef tx_result.apportioned_margin tx_result.margin_tax_rate fmul cvd /tx_result.franchise_tax xdef tx_result.franchise_tax apportionment.state_credits f- 0.0 fmax cvd /tx_result.franchise_tax xdef tx_result.franchise_tax cvd /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments apportionment.state_tax f- cvd /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "TX franchise tax: Standard rate 0.75%. NOT an income tax. Reference: TX Tax Code 171.002(a)" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No apportioned margin - no franchise tax; No TX franchise tax due - zero or negative margin
action_details.action_dsl: set tx_result.franchise_tax = 0.0; set apportionment.state_tax = 0.0; set apportionment.state_refund_or_owed = apportionment.state_payments; add "No TX franchise tax due - zero or negative margin. No loss carryforward. Reference: TX Tax Code 171.101" to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 cvd /tx_result.franchise_tax xdef 0.0 cvd /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments cvd /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "No TX franchise tax due - zero or negative margin. No loss carryforward. Reference: TX Tax Code 171.101" job.audit_trail swap addto
